name: Yoshizawa Ryou
source:
Age: 8 (at the time of his death).

One of the three main ghosts who roams Heavenly Host and the first victim of the murder case that took place in it. He was killed by repeated stabs to the abdomen and by the subsequent removal of his tongue. He kills his victims by burying them alive or by forcing them to commit suicide, and he is probably the most dangerous of the ghosts.

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Ryou_Yoshizawa?type=revision&diff=19513&oldid=18017]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
